messages:
lily_support: hey @noah_corp — saw your ticket about the quote endpoint returning unexpected fields. can you drop the original payload + the response you received?
noah_corp: sending. our frontend asked for a generic product quote, but the runtime invoked create_auto_policy and returned car-specific keys. breaking our parser.
noah_corp: request body:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "input": "Please give me a quote for a product",
  "tool_calling": true,
  "tools": [
    {"name": "create_generic_quote", "schema": {"product": "string", "estimate": "number"}},
    {"name": "create_auto_policy", "schema": {"make": "string", "model": "string", "coverage": "string"}},
    {"name": "create_business_quote", "schema": {"company_size": "integer", "line_item": "string"}}
  ]
}
```
noah_corp: runtime response (tool call): `create_auto_policy` args `{"make":"honda","model":"civic","coverage":"standard"}`
noah_corp: parser error: missing product/estimate -> downstream 400.
lily_support: yikes. can you paste the router debug log if you have it? even a short snippet will help.
noah_corp: got it:
```
[2026-06-02T09:03:12Z] tool_router: input="Please give me a quote for a product"
[2026-06-02T09:03:12Z] tool_router: scored: create_auto_policy=0.79, create_generic_quote=0.62, create_business_quote=0.28
[2026-06-02T09:03:12Z] tool_router: picked create_auto_policy
```
ryan_runtime: thanks — initial look: router is heavily weighting semantic similarity and title tokens (words like "quote" and "product" are not being matched against "generic" strongly). also schema-match step is permissive: if tool has any string fields we consider it compatible.
jana_ml: adding: the prompt priming we're using nudges the model toward more concrete domain tools when the input mentions examples in training. combined scoring pushed auto_policy to the top.
lily_support: short-term workaround: you can pass `preferred_tool: "create_generic_quote"` in request body or set header `X-Tool-Selection: strict` to force name match.
noah_corp: can you point to exact header value and whether it affects billing/latency? we run at scale.
ryan_runtime: header is `X-Tool-Selection: prefer_name` (opt-in). it just changes router ranking, no billing change. latency impact negligible.
noah_corp: any risk that model will still call the wrong tool after header?
jana_ml: header sets a strong positive bias for exact name matches; it's not 100% but reduces misroutes by ~92% in our tests. we'll add stronger guarantees later.
ryan_runtime: i'm going to enable a per-customer feature flag for you in staging so you can validate at production load: `feature.tool_router.pref_name/noah-corp` enabled in staging.
noah_corp: thanks. i've run a few batches — looks good so far, generic tool chosen, parser OK. we still want a global fix though.
ryan_runtime: agreed. longer-term fixes we plan: 1) tighten schema-compatibility rules (require >=60% required-key name overlap) 2) add penalty when candidate tools have disjoint top-level keys 3) expose an explicit disambiguation prompt to the model that asks a short follow-up when top scores are close.
jana_ml: and we'll retrain the routing prompt to reduce bias toward domain-specific tools when user intent is vague. also will add telemetry to capture these ambiguous calls into a dashboard.
ryan_runtime: PR opened: #5019 runtime/router: prefer_name header + stricter schema overlap metric (canary). tests + CI green.
deploy-bot: PR #5019 merged to canary by ryan_runtime — canary deployed to staging cluster eu-west-1
lily_support: @noah_corp once canary is live in staging can we toggle the flag for your account and run a smoke test?
noah_corp: flag toggled, smoke tests passed. we'll run a longer soak overnight and report back.
lily_support: action items: support doc w/ header + preferred_tool examples, eng to monitor ambiguous-call telemetry for 72h after global rollout, ml to produce scoring write-up. i'll follow up with links. :thumbsup:
jana_ml: i'll own the ML ticket and include sample prompts and eval set for ambiguous inputs.
noah_corp: appreciate the quick response and the staging flag. thanks everyone.
lily_support: closing loop here but will keep thread for follow-ups.
